And the LORD said to Moses and Aaron,
And the Lord said to Moses and to Aaron,
耶和華對摩西、亞倫說：
“Say to the Israelites, ‘When any man has a bodily discharge, the discharge is unclean.
Say to the children of Israel: If a man has an unclean flow from his flesh, it will make him unclean.
「你們曉諭以色列人說：人若身患漏症，他因這漏症就不潔淨了。
This uncleanness is from his discharge, whether his body allows the discharge to flow or blocks it. So his discharge will bring about uncleanness.
If the flow goes on or if the part is stopped up, to keep back the flow, he is still unclean.
他患漏症，無論是下流的，是止住的，都是不潔淨。
Any bed on which the man with the discharge lies will be unclean, and any furniture on which he sits will be unclean.
Every bed on which he has been resting will be unclean, and everything on which he has been seated will be unclean.
他所躺的床都為不潔淨，所坐的物也為不潔淨。
Anyone who touches his bed must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean until evening.
And anyone touching his bed is to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening.
凡摸那床的，必不潔淨到晚上，並要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
Whoever sits on furniture on which the man with the discharge was sitting must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean until evening.
And he who has been seated on anything on which the unclean man has been seated is to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening.
那坐患漏症人所坐之物的，必不潔淨到晚上，並要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
Whoever touches the body of the man with a discharge must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean until evening.
And anyone touching the flesh of the unclean man is to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening.
那摸患漏症人身體的，必不潔淨到晚上，並要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
If the man with the discharge spits on one who is clean, that person must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean until evening.
And if liquid from the mouth of the unclean man comes on to him who is clean, then he is to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening.
若患漏症人吐在潔淨的人身上，那人必不潔淨到晚上，並要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
Any saddle on which the man with the discharge rides will be unclean.
And any leather seat on a horse on which the unclean man has been seated will be unclean.
患漏症人所騎的鞍子也為不潔淨。
Whoever touches anything that was under him will be unclean until evening, and whoever carries such things must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean until evening.

And anyone touching anything which was under him will be unclean till the evening; anyone taking up any of these things is to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening.
凡摸了他身下之物的，必不潔淨到晚上；拿了那物的，必不潔淨到晚上，並要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
If the man with the discharge touches anyone without first rinsing his hands with water, the one who was touched must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean until evening.
And anyone on whom the unclean man puts his hands, without washing them in water, is to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening.
患漏症的人沒有用水涮手，無論摸了誰，誰必不潔淨到晚上，並要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
Any clay pot that the man with the discharge touches must be broken, and any wooden utensil must be rinsed with water.
And any vessel of earth which has been touched by the unclean man will have to be broken and any vessel of wood washed.
患漏症人所摸的瓦器就必打破；所摸的一切木器也必用水涮洗。
When the man has been cleansed from his discharge, he must count off seven days for his cleansing, wash his clothes, and bathe himself in fresh water, and he shall be clean.

And when a man who has a flow from his body is made clean from it, he is to take seven days to make himself clean, washing his clothing and bathing his body in flowing water, and then he will be clean.
「患漏症的人痊癒了，就要為潔淨自己計算七天，也必洗衣服，用活水洗身，就潔淨了。
On the eighth day he is to take two turtledoves or two young pigeons, come before the LORD at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, and give them to the priest.
And on the eighth day he is to take two doves or two young pigeons and come before the Lord to the door of the Tent of meeting and give them to the priest:
第八天，要取兩隻斑鳩或是兩隻雛鴿，來到會幕門口、耶和華面前，把鳥交給祭司。
The priest is to sacrifice them, one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering. In this way the priest will make atonement for the man before the LORD because of his discharge.
And they are to be offered by the priest, one for a sin-offering and one for a burned offering, and the priest will take away his sin before the Lord on account of his flow.
祭司要獻上一隻為贖罪祭，一隻為燔祭；因那人患的漏症，祭司要在耶和華面前為他贖罪。
When a man has an emission of semen, he must bathe his whole body with water, and he will be unclean until evening.
And if a man's seed goes out from him, then all his body will have to be bathed in water and he will be unclean till evening.
「人若夢遺，他必不潔淨到晚上，並要用水洗全身。
Any clothing or leather on which there is an emission of semen must be washed with water, and it will remain unclean until evening.
And any clothing or skin on which the seed comes is to be washed with water and be unclean till evening.
無論是衣服是皮子，被精所染，必不潔淨到晚上，並要用水洗。
If a man lies with a woman and there is an emission of semen, both must bathe with water, and they will remain unclean until evening.
And if a man has sex relations with a woman and his seed goes out from him, the two of them will have to be bathed in water and will be unclean till evening.
若男女交合，兩個人必不潔淨到晚上，並要用水洗澡。
When a woman has a discharge consisting of blood from her body, she will be unclean due to her menstruation for seven days, and anyone who touches her will be unclean until evening.
And if a woman has a flow of blood from her body, she will have to be kept separate for seven days, and anyone touching her will be unclean till evening.
「女人行經，必污穢七天；凡摸她的，必不潔淨到晚上。
Anything on which she lies or sits during her menstruation will be unclean,
And everything on which she has been resting, while she is kept separate, will be unclean, and everything on which she has been seated will be unclean.
女人在污穢之中，凡她所躺的物件都為不潔淨，所坐的物件也都不潔淨。
and anyone who touches her bed must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean until evening.
And anyone touching her bed will have to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening.
凡摸她床的，必不潔淨到晚上，並要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
Whoever touches any furniture on which she was sitting must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean until evening.
And anyone touching anything on which she has been seated will have to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening.
凡摸她所坐甚麼物件的，必不潔淨到晚上，並要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
And whether it is a bed or furniture on which she was sitting, whoever touches it will be unclean until evening.
Anyone touching anything on the bed or on the thing on which she has been seated, will be unclean till evening.
在女人的床上，或在她坐的物上，若有別的物件，人一摸了，必不潔淨到晚上。
If a man lies with her and her menstrual flow touches him, he will be unclean for seven days, and any bed on which he lies will become unclean.
And if any man has sex relations with her so that her blood comes on him, he will be unclean for seven days and every bed on which he has been resting will be unclean.
男人若與那女人同房，染了她的污穢，就要七天不潔淨；所躺的床也為不潔淨。

When a woman has a discharge of her blood for many days at a time other than her menstrual period, or if it continues beyond her period, she will be unclean all the days of her unclean discharge, just as she is during the days of her menstruation.

And if a woman has a flow of blood for a long time, not at the time when she generally has it, or if the flow goes on longer than the normal time, she will be unclean while the flow of blood goes on, as she is at other normal times.
「女人若在經期以外患多日的血漏，或是經期過長，有了漏症，她就因這漏症不潔淨，與她在經期不潔淨一樣。
Any bed on which she lies or any furniture on which she sits during the days of her discharge will be unclean, like her bed during her menstrual period.
Every bed on which she has been resting will be unclean, as at the times when she normally has a flow of blood, and everything on which she has been seated will be unclean, in the same way.
她在患漏症的日子所躺的床、所坐的物都要看為不潔淨，與她月經的時候一樣。
Anyone who touches these things will be unclean; he must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean until evening.
And anyone touching these things will be unclean, and his clothing will have to be washed and his body bathed in water and he will be unclean till evening.
凡摸這些物件的，就為不潔淨，必不潔淨到晚上，並要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
When a woman is cleansed of her discharge, she must count off seven days, and after that she will be ceremonially clean.
But when her flow of blood is stopped, after seven days she will be clean.
女人的漏症若好了，就要計算七天，然後才為潔淨。
On the eighth day she is to take two turtledoves or two young pigeons and bring them to the priest at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
And on the eighth day let her get two doves or two young pigeons and take them to the priest to the door of the Tent of meeting,
第八天，要取兩隻斑鳩或是兩隻雛鴿，帶到會幕門口給祭司。
The priest is to sacrifice one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering. In this way the priest will make atonement for her before the LORD for her unclean discharge.
To be offered by the priest, one for a sin-offering and one for a burned offering; and the priest will take away her sin before the Lord on account of her unclean condition.
祭司要獻一隻為贖罪祭，一隻為燔祭；因那人血漏不潔，祭司要在耶和華面前為她贖罪。
You must keep the children of Israel separate from their uncleanness, so that they do not die by defiling My tabernacle, which is among them.

In this way may the children of Israel be made free from all sorts of unclean conditions, so that death may not overtake them when they are unclean and when they make unclean my holy place which is among them.
「你們要這樣使以色列人與他們的污穢隔絕，免得他們玷污我的帳幕，就因自己的污穢死亡。」
This is the law of him who has a discharge, of the man who has an emission of semen whereby he is unclean,
This is the law for the man who has a flow from his body, or whose seed goes from him so that he is unclean;
這是患漏症和夢遺而不潔淨的，
of a woman in her menstrual period, of any male or female who has a discharge, and of a man who lies with an unclean woman.’”
And for her who has a flow of blood, and for any man or woman who has an unclean flow, and for him who has sex relations with a woman when she is unclean.
並有月經病的和患漏症的，無論男女，並人與不潔淨女人同房的條例。
